unit_cn: Unit 3 On the Move 运动
source: 外研社版(新标准)必修第二册 Unit 3 词表(p122-123 真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、运动/健身主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Surfing is a popular water sport along the coast.
words.example_cn: 冲浪是沿海地区很受欢迎的一项水上运动。

words.example_en: He was proud to represent his country at the Olympic Games.
words.example_cn: 他为能在奥运会上代表自己的国家而自豪。

words.example_en: She scored the winning goal in the last minute of the match.
words.example_cn: 她在比赛最后一分钟攻入了制胜一球。

words.example_en: Good footwork is the basis of every great player's skill.
words.example_cn: 良好的脚法是每位优秀球员技术的基础。

words.example_en: You don't need expensive equipment to start running.
words.example_cn: 开始跑步并不需要昂贵的装备。

words.example_en: The children played football to their heart's content until dark.
words.example_cn: 孩子们尽情地踢球,一直踢到天黑。

words.example_en: Poor children often play with a ball made of plastic bags.
words.example_cn: 贫困的孩子们常常玩用塑料袋做成的球。

words.example_en: Excitement on the field is a key factor behind football's popularity.
words.example_cn: 赛场上的激情是足球受欢迎的一个关键因素。

words.example_en: Good players know how to pass, score and defend.
words.example_cn: 优秀的球员懂得如何传球、得分和防守。

words.example_en: The game ended with a surprising twist in the final seconds.
words.example_cn: 比赛在最后几秒出现了惊人的转折而结束。

words.example_en: On Christmas Day the soldiers put down their guns and played football.
words.example_cn: 在圣诞节那天,士兵们放下枪一起踢起了足球。

words.example_en: For one moment of peace during the conflict, the two sides played together.
words.example_cn: 在战争中那一刻的和平里,双方一起踢了球。

words.phrase_en: a matter of life and death
words.example_en: Some fans treat football as a matter of life and death.
words.example_cn: 有些球迷把足球当成生死攸关的大事。

words.example_en: I can assure you that regular exercise will make you feel better.
words.example_cn: 我可以向你保证,经常锻炼会让你感觉更好。

words.example_en: The watch helps you chart your training progress week by week.
words.example_cn: 这块手表能帮你逐周记录训练进展。

words.example_en: This sports watch is the ideal choice for a keen athlete.
words.example_cn: 这块运动手表是热衷运动者的理想选择。

words.example_en: The watch has a digital display that records your speed and distance.
words.example_cn: 这块手表有一个能记录速度和距离的数字显示屏。

words.example_en: The device can monitor your heart rate while you run.
words.example_cn: 这个装置能在你跑步时监测心率。

words.example_en: The voice-control setting lets you stay hands-free during exercise.
words.example_cn: 语音控制功能让你在运动时无须用手操作。

words.example_en: The waterproof band is fully adjustable, so it feels comfortable.
words.example_cn: 这条防水表带可以完全调节,所以戴着很舒服。

words.example_en: The new sports watch is only available online.
words.example_cn: 这款新运动手表只能在网上买到。

words.example_en: Using only a rope, you can skip almost anywhere.
words.example_cn: 只要一根绳子,你几乎在任何地方都能跳绳。

words.example_en: The plank develops your core muscles and strengthens your lower back.
words.example_cn: 平板支撑能锻炼你的核心肌群并增强下背部力量。

words.example_en: Skipping helps you improve your footwork and balance.
words.example_cn: 跳绳有助于改善你的脚法和平衡。

words.example_en: Find a bar that will support your weight for pull-ups.
words.example_cn: 找一根能承受你体重的横杆做引体向上。

words.example_en: Pull-ups build strength in your upper body, especially your arms.
words.example_cn: 引体向上能增强上半身尤其是手臂的力量。

words.example_en: Regular jogging helps build strong leg bones.
words.example_cn: 经常慢跑有助于强健腿骨。

words.example_en: Tai chi involves doing very slow physical exercises.
words.example_cn: 太极拳包含做一些非常缓慢的身体动作。

words.example_en: A great master of tai chi lives in the town of Yangshuo.
words.example_cn: 一位太极大师住在阳朔镇。

words.example_en: Listen carefully to each response the athlete gives.
words.example_cn: 认真听运动员给出的每一个回答。

words.example_en: Charts help us interpret facts and figures more quickly.
words.example_cn: 图表帮助我们更快地解读事实和数据。

words.example_en: Bar charts can be used to compare data over time.
words.example_cn: 条形图可以用来比较一段时间内的数据。

words.example_en: Read the labels along the sides of the chart carefully.
words.example_cn: 仔细阅读图表两侧的标记。

words.example_en: I was born with asthma and never thought I'd become a runner.
words.example_cn: 我天生患有哮喘,从没想过自己会成为一名跑者。

words.example_en: My doctor said that exercise could improve how my lungs work.
words.example_cn: 医生说锻炼能改善我肺部的功能。

words.example_en: I discovered a running app called Running Power.
words.example_cn: 我发现了一款叫作 Running Power 的跑步应用。

words.example_en: The app lists your performance against others in your network.
words.example_cn: 这款应用会把你和你关系网里其他人的表现作对比。

words.example_en: By the end of the run, all the tension had left my mind.
words.example_cn: 跑步结束时,我心里所有的紧张都消失了。

words.example_en: After running, my stress seems to disappear completely.
words.example_cn: 跑步之后,我的压力似乎完全消失了。

words.example_en: Each runner in the charity race wears a gorilla suit.
words.example_cn: 慈善赛中的每位跑者都穿着大猩猩服装。

words.example_en: It is hot and sweaty inside the gorilla suit.
words.example_cn: 大猩猩服装里又热又出汗。

words.example_en: My legs ache after a long run, but it is still fun.
words.example_cn: 长跑之后我的腿很酸痛,但仍然很有趣。

words.example_en: These running stories inspire me to keep going.
words.example_cn: 这些跑步故事激励着我坚持下去。

words.example_en: My teacher persuaded me to try ice hockey.
words.example_cn: 我的老师说服我去尝试冰球。

words.example_en: We hope to become national champions one day.
words.example_cn: 我们希望有朝一日成为全国冠军。

words.example_en: My ultimate goal is to become an ice hockey coach.
words.example_cn: 我的最终目标是成为一名冰球教练。
